identity.name: ResumeAI - The Obsidian Architect
identity.description: A high-contrast, futuristic interface that treats the resume not as a document, but as a data artifact being refined. Deep blacks, glowing accents, and holographic surfaces.

typography.instructions: Import fonts from Google Fonts. Use Space Grotesk for all Headings (h1-h4). Use Manrope for body text. Use JetBrains Mono for code snippets, ATS scores, and data metrics.

landing_page.structure: Asymmetrical bento grid. Hero section uses col-span-full. Feature cards mix 1x1, 2x1, and 2x2 spans.

dashboard.structure: Split screen. Left: Resume Preview (Holographic Paper). Right: Analysis & Controls (Dark Glass Panels). Sticky header for actions.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(99,102,241,0.5)] transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-border text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:border-primary hover:text-primary transition-all duration-300

cards.default: bg-surface/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-6 hover:border-primary/30 transition-colors
cards.highlight: bg-gradient-to-br from-surface_highlight to-surface border border-primary/20 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-lg

inputs.style: bg-surface border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-white focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-text_muted

resume_preview.style: bg-white/90 text-black rounded-sm shadow-2xl min-h-[800px] p-8 transform scale-[0.95] origin-top hover:scale-100 transition-transform duration-500 ease-out

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. FONTS: Add Space Grotesk and Manrope via Google Fonts in index.html or CSS import.
3. THEME: Force DARK MODE by default. Do not implement a light mode toggle unless absolutely necessary. The brand is 'Obsidian'.
4. LAYOUT: For the Resume Upload/Analysis page, use a Split View. Left 50% = Resume Preview (Scrollable). Right 50% = AI Chat/Suggestions (Scrollable).
5. ATS SCORE: Visualize the ATS score using a circular progress bar with a glowing path. <70 = Red, 70-85 = Yellow, >85 = Green/Cyan.
6. APPROVAL FLOW: When suggesting changes, show a 'Diff' view (Old vs New). Use Green highlight for additions, Red strikethrough for deletions.
7. PDF GENERATION: Use 'react-pdf' or 'jspdf' for generating the final resume. Ensure the output is clean and standard (white background, black text) even if the app is dark mode.
8. MICRO-INTERACTIONS: Add subtle hover glows to all interactive elements. Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications (e.g., 'Resume Uploaded', 'Changes Applied').
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic gradients. Use noise/grain overlays for texture.
Avoid 'Inter' for headings. Use Space Grotesk.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (APCA standards).
Never use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns/modals without a blur.
